summary: Standalone execution nodes (type execution) run jobs only and hop nodes (type hop) only relay traffic; both are outside the Kubernetes cluster and connect via Receptor, and the execution node time zone must match settings.TIME_ZONE (default UTC) for fact caching.
questions: What is the difference between a hop node and an execution node?
Why must execution node time zone match controller?
How do I add an execution node to an OpenShift controller?
Fact caching broken on execution node time zone
